'''Cooked large fish''' is a [[food]] item made by cooking any large fish. It heals {{Value|Cooked Large Fish|heals}}. It replaces {{MCW|Cooked Salmon|cooked salmon}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Cooking ===
Cooked large fish is made from anything in the large fish group: [[salmon]] and the 24 custom fish that are salmon (see [[Fish]]). One recipe, with the group as its ingredient, replaces the salmon recipe of 1.12.2. Cooking takes {{Value|Cooked Large Fish|cook_time}} in an [[Oven]] or on [[Kindling]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/cooked_large_fish.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/tags/item/fish_large.json}}</ref> A [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] chars it instead.
{{Recipes}}

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
Eating it gives a hidden Regeneration III for 60 ticks (3 seconds), which heals {{Value|Cooked Large Fish|heals}}.
